subject: Entirely Different Results between Mplus and Lavaan for the same CFA model

messages.author: 85b6c473da3ef97d
messages.subject: Entirely Different Results between Mplus and Lavaan for the same CFA model
parts:
Dear lavaan group,

I'm wondering whether I could get some insights from this community. 

I have been trying to fit a two-factor CFA model to nine observed indicators, with V1-V6 indicating the first latent variable, and V7-V9 indicating the second latent variable. I tried to fit this simple model in both lavaan and Mplus but have obtained entirely different results. The parameter estimates are different, as well as the model fit measures. 

I have double-checked the parameters table in both programs, and made sure I had the same free parameters across Mplus and lavaan. The data were also exactly the same. I'm wondering whether this is merely an issue about the optimizers or if there is a deeper issue I did not fully understand between the two programs? 

With the following lavaan model syntax

model <- '

F1 =~ NA*V1 + V2 + V3 + V4 + V5 + V6
F2 =~ NA*V7 + V8 + V9

F1 ~~ 1*F1
F2 ~~ 1*F2

F1 ~~ F2
'

Here is the relevant output:
